column1: # FAIRe terms that people often confuse, even in review. When propose mapping proposes one, it always
# marks the row for review, and the comment names the other terms of its group with their meaning and
# asks the group's question. One row per term: group (a short name shared by the terms people mix
# up), term (the FAIRe term name), meaning (a plain description), check (the question that tells them
# apart; give it on one row of the group, or repeat it).

column3: the shallowest depth the sample was taken from, in metres below the water, sediment or soil surface; the same as maximumDepthInMeters for a sample from one depth
column4: Is this column the depth the sample was taken from, or the depth of the water at the site? A surface sample at a site 15 m deep has 0 in minimumDepthInMeters and maximumDepthInMeters, and 15 in tot_depth_water_col

column3: the deepest depth the sample was taken from, in metres below the water, sediment or soil surface; the same as minimumDepthInMeters for a sample from one depth
the depth of the water column at the site, from the surface to the bottom, in metres
